description: Election Commission - S. A. Rakuman was elected as the member of the Musali Pradeshiya Sabha - J. K. M. G. Perera was elected as the member of the Katana Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the filling of vacancies in local government bodies (Musalai Pradeshiya Sabha and Katana Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's death and a member ceasing to belong to a party. It specifically deals with electoral processes under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including the nomination and declaration of newly elected members to fill these vacancies. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it involves electoral procedures and declarations rather than government personnel appointments or structural changes.
